# Mountain Warehouse

> Mountain Warehouse is a UK-based outdoor retailer offering comprehensive clothing, footwear, and camping equipment for men, women, and kids across all seasons and activities.

Founded and headquartered in London (Compass House, 7A Howick Place, London SW1P 1DZ), Mountain Warehouse specializes in affordable outdoor apparel and gear including waterproof jackets, walking boots, camping equipment, and seasonal collections. The company serves outdoor enthusiasts of all levels with product ranges spanning casual hiking to skiing and festival camping.

## Key Topics

- Outdoor clothing
- Waterproof jackets
- Walking boots
- Camping gear
- Mens/Womens/Kids apparel
- Sleeping bags
- Tents
- Gilets and body warmers
- Fleece layers
- Softshell jackets
- Ski wear
- Footwear
- Activewear
- Seasonal collections
- Outdoor equipment
